{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Archives of Naboo, Vol. 2453''' was a document that contained former [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] [[Pars Varqom]]'s personal memoirs of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and its aftermath.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], writer of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', eventually cut any mentioning of the Royal Archives of Naboo in the final product. The character was later made [[canon]]ical (but now within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]]) in the [[StarWars.com]] blog post [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 6 — Showdown at Naboo'']].
